welcome.intro: Report wildlife conflict safely and help officers respond with verified information.
welcome.builtFor: Built for communities near Sri Lanka's protected areas
welcome.builtForBody: Simple reporting, transparent status updates, and practical safety advice.

signIn.title: Welcome back
signIn.subtitle: Sign in with your community or staff account.
signIn.forgotBody: Password resets are handled by your organisation. Please contact your Community Liaison Officer.
signIn.roleBody: The same app opens a separate interface for villagers and liaison officers.
signIn.staffNote: Staff accounts are assigned by the organization.
signIn.invalidCredentials: The account or password is not correct.
signIn.notConfigured: The app is not connected to the server yet. Add your Supabase details to mobile/.env.

createAccount.title: Create account
createAccount.subtitle: Register as a community reporter.
createAccount.consent: I agree to use my contact details for report follow-up and safety communication.

home.heroBody: Send a quick report so a liaison officer can verify it.
home.heroCaption: Sri Lankan elephant near village edge
home.injuredBody: Call {{number}} first, then submit the report.
home.noReports: You haven't submitted any reports yet.

categories.title: What is happening?
categories.subtitle: Choose the closest match.
categories.notSureBody: Choose Other animal and report what you can safely observe.

details.title: Report details
details.locationDenied: Location unavailable. Choose your village instead.
details.locationOutside: Your location is outside the covered area. Choose your village instead.
details.photoOptional: Optional — only if it is safe
details.photoSafe: Only take a photo if it is safe to do so.
details.photoPermission: Camera permission is needed to take a photo. You can still send the report without one.
details.photoTooLarge: That photo is too large. Choose a smaller one or send without a photo.
details.photoUnsupported: Use a JPG, PNG or WebP photo, or send without a photo.
details.keepDistance: Keep your distance. Do not approach the animal.
details.ifInjured: If anyone is injured, call {{number}} first.

urgent.title: Someone is injured? Call {{number}} first.
urgent.body: Call the Suwa Seriya ambulance service now. Then send this report so a liaison officer is alerted immediately.

confirmation.title: Report received
confirmation.officerNote: An officer will check this report.
confirmation.officerNoteBody: Field action is only shown after verification.
confirmation.queuedBody: We'll retry automatically. You do not need to send it again.
confirmation.queuedNote: Your report is stored on this phone and will be sent as soon as there is a connection.
confirmation.failedTitle: We could not send this report
confirmation.failedBody: Please check the details and try sending it again.

reports.title: My reports
reports.subtitle: Track what happens after you report.
reports.empty: You haven't submitted any reports yet.
reports.outcomeVerified: A liaison officer confirmed your report. Thank you for helping keep people and wildlife safe.
reports.outcomeFieldAction: Field action has been requested for this report.
reports.outcomeRejected: Thank you for reporting. We could not confirm this report. Please report again if the situation continues.

pending.savedNote: Saved safely on this phone. We'll retry automatically.
pending.failedNote: This report could not be accepted by the server.

safety.title: Safety tips
safety.subtitle: Quick guidance for common situations.
safety.heroBody: Stay calm, keep a safe distance, and avoid blocking its path.
safety.tip1Body: Do not approach wildlife to take photos.
safety.tip3Body: Use GPS or choose your village from the list.

queue.title: Verification queue
queue.subtitle: Pending community reports in your assigned divisions.

incident.collarLine: {{code}} detected about {{distance}} m from this location.
incident.collarNone: No collar or camera data nearby.
incident.callBack: Place not recognized. The reporter's registered village is shown. Please call them back.

verify.title: Verify report
verify.subtitle: Record the decision and field action.
verify.notesPlaceholder: Add notes about how you checked this report.
verify.rangersBody: On-duty field team will receive the verified incident.
verify.doneField: Report verified and the field team was notified.
verify.doneFieldFailed: Report verified. The field team notification could not be sent; please contact them directly.

reject.title: Reject report
reject.subtitle: A reason is required for the audit trail.
reject.warning: Rejecting removes the marker from the live map but keeps the report in history.
reject.done: Report rejected. The reporter has been informed.

map.title: Community map
map.subtitle: Only reports inside your assigned divisions.
map.empty: No active reports on the map.
map.tapMarker: Tap a marker to see the report.

history.title: Verification history
history.subtitle: Your recent decisions and audit trail.

profile.title: Profile
profile.helpBody: Open the Queue, check each report by call, visit, photo or sensor data, then verify it or reject it with a reason. Always call {{number}} first if someone is injured.

sms.title: SMS simulator
sms.subtitle: Demo only: simulates a villager texting the report short code.
sms.duplicate: Grouped with an earlier report of the same herd
sms.disabled: The SMS simulator is switched off on the server.

validation.accountRequired: Enter your mobile number or email.
validation.accountInvalid: Enter a valid mobile number or email.
validation.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid mobile number, e.g. 077 123 4567.
validation.notesTooLong: Notes can be up to 1000 characters.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have access to this.
errors.outOfScope: This report is outside your assigned divisions.
errors.validation: Some details are missing or invalid.
errors.phoneRegistered: This mobile number is already registered. Try signing in.
errors.villageNotFound: That village could not be found.
errors.locationUnavailable: Location unavailable. Choose your village instead.
errors.alreadyReviewed: Another officer has already reviewed this report.
errors.notFound: That report could not be found.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.

confirm.signOutMessage: Are you sure you want to sign out?
